SAF-01 prevents negative balances, which is crucial for user trust and financial safety. SAF-02 ensures that funds are automatically withdrawn from the related saving account, promoting reliability in transactions. SAF-03 mandates user notification and transaction termination for insufficient funds, enhancing user safety. SAF-04 logs all transactions for accountability, while SAF-05 secures user authentication. SAF-06 allows for safe degradation during maintenance, and SAF-07 provides users with a clear summary of account status. transcript.statement: The requirements I propose ensure the security and privacy of user data within the ATM system. TRU-01 mandates encryption for all transactions, safeguarding sensitive information during transmission. TRU-02 emphasizes secure PIN authentication, crucial for access control. TRU-03 ensures all transactions are logged for auditability, while TRU-04 prevents negative balances, aligning with data integrity. TRU-05 allows users to securely review their transaction history, enhancing transparency. TRU-06 notifies users of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals, promoting informed decision-making. TRU-07 maintains data integrity by validating account operations. I see conflicts with RES-04 and SAF-05, as they overlap in secure PIN verification but may not fully address the broader security and privacy concerns adequately.

EFF-01 ensures transactions are processed within 3 seconds, promoting user responsiveness. EFF-02 maintains a throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute, crucial for high-demand environments. EFF-03 optimizes data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history. EFF-04 prevents negative balances, aligning with safety but also ensuring efficient transaction processing. EFF-05 allows automatic fund withdrawal without user delay, enhancing efficiency. EFF-06 provides immediate feedback on withdrawal requests, improving user experience. EFF-07 implements load balancing for effective transaction management. I see conflicts with SAF-02 and RES-05, as they may introduce delays in fund withdrawal processes, impacting overall efficiency.

GRN-03 emphasizes the use of energy-efficient hardware, while GRN-04 ensures that transaction logging minimizes data storage requirements, reducing resource use. requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account only when compliant with safety and regulations.
The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds while including energy efficiency metrics.
The ATM system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute while including energy efficiency metrics.
The ATM system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
